user.title: Connect to Blink
user.description: Sign in to your Blink account. Your password is used for authentication and is not stored by Blink Plus.

mfa.title: Verify your Blink account
mfa.description: Enter the verification code Blink sent you.

error.invalid_auth: Blink rejected these credentials or this code.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Blink. Try again later.
error.unknown: Blink setup failed. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Blink account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally used for this integration.

init.title: Blink Plus settings
init.description: Live sessions start on demand. HA may retain a stream briefly after its viewer closes. Leave stream preloading off, especially for battery cameras. Sensor polling does not wake cameras for fresh snapshots. Select pan/tilt only for cameras with a compatible motorized mount.

data_description.usb_clip_minutes: Only for a Sync Module 2 with a USB drive. Reading the list makes the module scan the drive, and the Blink app may show "system busy" meanwhile. Regular polling asks the module for nothing else.

data.usb_clip_minutes: Read the USB clip list every N minutes (0 = never)
data.reconnect_cooldown: Cooldown after a live session times out or fails (seconds)
data.recording_directory: Recording folder (blank uses the Home Assistant media folder)
data.sidebar_panel: Show the Blink Plus page in the sidebar

error.invalid_options: Choose values within the displayed limits and select existing cameras.

trigger_camera.name: Take a snapshot
trigger_camera.description: Asks the camera for a new picture (wakes it) and waits until Blink has published it.

start_live_view.name: Start live view
start_live_view.description: Opens the camera's live view and keeps it open, so a player or play_audio finds it streaming. Calling it again extends the time. Returns the live view state.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to keep the live view open; at most the maximum live session.

stop_live_view.name: Stop live view
stop_live_view.description: Ends what start_live_view keeps open and closes the camera's live session.

play_audio.name: Play audio
play_audio.description: Plays an audio file through the camera speaker while its live view is open (at most 60 seconds). Waits briefly for a live view that is still starting.

file_path.name: File
file_path.description: Absolute path of an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, ...) in a folder Home Assistant allows, for example under /media.
